## 17 CFR Part 243 — Regulation FD

US Securities and Exchange Commission · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-243>

**Authoritative for:** When selective disclosure of material nonpublic information triggers a mandatory public disclosure, and on what timeline. The rule that decides whether a given investor conversation was lawful.

## Delaware General Corporation Law

State of Delaware · US-DE · public domain — quote freely

<https://delcode.delaware.gov/title8/c001/index.html>

**Authoritative for:** What a board may and may not do — board power, interested-director transactions, exculpation, merger mechanics and appraisal rights. Primary law for most US public companies and nearly every venture-backed one.

## NYSE Listed Company Manual

New York Stock Exchange · US · **read and cite only — copyrighted, do not reproduce**

<https://nyse.wolterskluwer.cloud/listed-company-manual>

**Authoritative for:** What a listed issuer must do to stay listed — board independence tests, committee composition, shareholder approval thresholds and immediate disclosure obligations. Binding as a listing condition.
